Real-encoder fixture corpus
===========================

Every file here was generated for this project with real production encoders,
so the corpus is licensing-clean (no third-party media) while carrying the
real container structures device files have. Each file embeds "Fixture ..."
marker strings that tests/real_device.rs asserts are removed by cleaning.

apple-imageio-gps.jpg / apple-imageio-gps.heic
  Apple ImageIO (CGImageDestination) on macOS with TIFF/EXIF/GPS dictionaries:
  Make=Apple, Model=iPhone 15 Pro, artist, lens, body serial number, capture
  timestamps, and GPS coordinates. Same encoder code path as iPhone captures;
  the HEIC stores EXIF and XMP as iloc items the way iPhone files do
  (including the XMP infe with an empty item name).

apple-quicktime-location.mov
  ffmpeg/libx264 base clip re-exported through AVFoundation
  (AVAssetExportSession, QuickTime muxer) with
  com.apple.quicktime.location.ISO6709 and creation-date metadata items,
  matching the moov/meta/ilst layout of iPhone videos.

ffmpeg-location.mp4
  ffmpeg/libx264 with title and encoder tags in moov/udta/meta/ilst.

ffmpeg-lame-id3.mp3
  ffmpeg/libmp3lame sine clip with ID3v2.3 title/artist/comment frames.

ffmpeg-flac-tags.flac
  ffmpeg/flac sine clip with Vorbis comments (title/artist + vendor string)
  and an attached PICTURE block (PNG cover art).

ffmpeg-wav-info-bext.wav
  ffmpeg PCM sine clip with LIST/INFO tags (INAM/IART/ICMT/ISFT) and a
  Broadcast Wave bext chunk (-write_bext 1).

ffmpeg-vorbis-tags.ogg / ffmpeg-opus-tags.opus
  ffmpeg OGG Vorbis (native encoder) and Opus (libopus) sine clips with
  title/artist Vorbis comments and encoder vendor strings.

Regenerating: any macOS with Xcode CLT + ffmpeg can rebuild equivalents
(CGImageDestinationAddImage with kCGImagePropertyTIFF/Exif/GPS dictionaries;
AVAssetExportSession passthrough with quickTimeMetadata items; ffmpeg
-metadata flags). Keep files tiny and marker strings intact.

Local-only corpus: point METADATA_REMOVER_FIXTURE_DIR at a folder of real
personal files (e.g. iPhone photos/videos) and run `cargo test` to push them
through the same detect -> validate -> clean -> re-validate pipeline without
committing them.
